## Summary

I implemented `listTools` and `callTool` in `server.mjs`, following the MCP builder skill guidance (explicit input schemas with `additionalProperties: false`, validated inputs, clean errors).

**`listTools`** exposes two tools:
- `note_create` — requires non-empty `title` and `body` (strings)
- `note_get` — requires `note_id` (string)

Both schemas are strict objects with `additionalProperties: false`.

**`callTool`**:
- Stores notes in an in-memory `Map`, using stable generated ids of the form `n1`, `n2`, … (a monotonic counter)
- Returns structured `content` arrays with `{ type: 'text', text }` items
- Rejects empty/missing title or body, empty/missing note_id, unknown note ids, and unknown tool names with clear error messages

**Verification:**
- `npm test` → 2/2 passing
- Extra edge-case checks (unknown tool, empty title, missing body, empty id, nonexistent note, happy path, strict schemas) all behave correctly
